test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution: The correct answer is **him**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In the **first** line of the passage: • *A poet visited Tenali Raman hoping to impress him with some poems **he** had written.* • It is clear that the poet is male, '**he**' will become '**him**' in the second sentence. • We use him to refer to a **man, boy, or male animal.** • Therefore, the correct answer is 'him'. • Hence, the correct option is **2**. **Correct Paragraph__:** *A poet visited Tenali Raman hoping to impress him with some poems he had written. Raman asked __**him**__ to leave the poems with him and promised to read them (2) ______. The man, however, insisted on (3) ______ out the poems to him. As the poet droned (4) ______ Raman fell asleep. When he woke up, the poet asked: “Sir, shall I read the (5) ______ again?"* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • गद्यांश की पहली पंक्ति में: • *एक कवि तेनाली रमन के पास उनके द्वारा लिखी गई कुछ कविताओं से उन्हें प्रभावित करने की आशा से आया।* • स्पष्ट है कि कवि पुरुष है, दूसरे वाक्य में '**he**' '**him**' बन जाएगा। • आप उसका उपयोग किसी **आदमी, लड़के या नर जानवर के संदर्भ में करते हैं।** • अतः इसका सही उत्तर 'उसे' (Him) है। • अत: सही विकल्प **2** है। 49:T17e1, The correct answer is **Later**.
